safety: prompt-free calls only; no capture, no synthetic events, no Apple events, no window titles recorded
tcc_attribution_caveat: the probe ran from a DSH shell (bash <- node <- ~/.volta/bin/dsh <- launchd); TCC attributes it to its responsible process, so the preflight values describe that host, not a future helper app

windows.note: window names are not printed; per WWDC19-701 name and sharing state are withheld unless the caller is approved for Screen Recording

codesign.reading: a and b are identical-source rebuilds with the same output name, byte-identical with the same cdhash; c changes one string constant and gets a new cdhash; the ad hoc designated requirement is the cdhash itself, so any code change breaks a grant keyed to it (TN3127). An earlier run with different output names (probe-1, probe-2) also changed the cdhash because the linker uses the file name as the code-signing identifier.

observations: One active display, 1920x1080 points = 1920x1080 pixels, scale 1, main, not built-in; system_profiler product id 76697274 decodes to ASCII virt (inference - a virtual or dummy display, not Retina)
Every TCC preflight is false for the DSH host: Screen Recording, PostEvent, ListenEvent, Accessibility

CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo returned 26 on-screen windows; only 2 carry a window name and all 26 carry kCGWindowSharingState, which does not match the WWDC19 statement that name and sharing state are withheld without Screen Recording (unexplained on macOS 27; names not recorded)
